typed-result-propagation
exact_cases.source:
enum AppError:
  Rejected(reason: Text)

fn fail() -> Result<Int, AppError>:
  Err(Rejected("detail"))

fn relay() -> Result<Int, AppError>:
  let value = fail()?
  Ok(value + 1)

fn main() -> Text:
  match relay():
    Ok(value) => int_text(value)
    Err(error) => match error:
      Rejected(reason) => "rejected:" + reason
